figurative_meaning_en: The ritual of providing Ganga water to the mouth of a dying person
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মৃত্যুক্ষণে পরিবারের সদস্যরা গঙ্গাজলি করল।
প্রাচীন সংস্কার অনুসারে গঙ্গাজলি অত্যন্ত পবিত্র বলে বিবেচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: The family performed Ganga jali at his deathbed.
According to ancient customs, Ganga jali is considered highly sacred.
history: This practice stems from Hindu beliefs where Ganga water is believed to grant moksha (liberation) to the soul of the dying person, purifying sins and ensuring a peaceful afterlife.
note: Refers to a sacred Hindu ritual deeply embedded in Bengali Hindu traditions.
